author: Bobby Grayson
description: clock, mapset and strings import Leanactors.Time / .SetList / .Str, which are not dependencies of Leanactors.Sys, so 'lake build Leanactors.Sys' left no oleans for them and 'lake env lean' reported "object file ... does not exist". It never showed on a developer machine because .lake was already warm from an earlier full lake build, and it could not fail check.sh because of the grep pipeline above. In a fresh worktree ./check.sh on main fails at the fixtures step for this reason. Fixed by deriving the modules to build from the expected files' own import lines.
title: Second hole the new gate exposed: run_fixtures built only Leanactors.Sys, so a COLD .lake failed three fixtures
